arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Worker rising from crouch toward a front/right three-quarter stance with knees still wide and bent. One arm descends down-left holding ONE charcoal hammer at low knee height on screen-left; other arm descends almost vertically along screen-right chest/thigh edge. Both feet planted wide. Face/head turns to right with visible near eye and only naturally visible far-eye sliver. Complete two arms, no extra third hand in the hammer overlap. This is a squat-to-stand transition, not walking. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs. Image3 supplies the EXACT same tool identity: compact rectangular charcoal metal mallet head with charcoal handle, no claw, no brown wood. Rotate that same tool to the source angle and keep the original grip/occlusion. Image3 pose is irrelevant.
